payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Alfred, Diana

payload.content: Hi Alfred, I'm Diana. Availability 10.0, skill devops:0.74. My costs: backend tasks low (2.13-4.26), ui-ux tasks high (25-50). I'm likely to pick one of ISSUE-0001::review, ::docs, ::triage (cost 2.13 each). What are you planning to avoid duplicates?

Hi Diana, thanks for sharing. I'm Alfred, availability 6.0, skills backend:0.75, ui-ux-design:0.67. I'm considering taking either ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 4.23) or ISSUE-0001::test (cost 2.96) to avoid overlapping with your likely choices (review/docs/triage). Alternatively, I could take a ui-ux-design task from ISSUE-0002. What backend task are you planning to take exactly? Let's coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Alfred, thanks for the clarification. I'm planning to take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.13) to keep my cost low. If you take implement or test, that should avoid overlap with me. I'll coordinate with Tabatha to ensure we don't pick the same review/docs/triage task. What exactly are you leaning towards: implement or test?

Diana, I've decided to take ISSUE-0001::docs (backend docs) to avoid overlap with your review. This task has cost 2.11, effort 1.0, priority critical. Let me know if you have any concerns. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Alfred, I see you're planning to take docs to avoid my review. However, Tabatha is also planning to take docs (from our coordination on blackboard 2). To avoid duplicate, would you be willing to take triage instead? I'll take review, and Tabatha can take docs. Let me know if that works for you. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Diana, I agree to take triage to avoid duplicate with Tabatha. So you take review, Tabatha takes docs, I take triage. Hollis is taking ISSUE-0002::review (ui-ux). No duplicates. Let me know if you have any concerns.
Final plan: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Please confirm if this still works for you to avoid duplicates.

Alfred, Tabatha: Let's resolve the conflict. I propose: Alfred takes ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.11), Tabatha takes ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.05), I take ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.13). This avoids duplicates and keeps costs low. Please confirm if this works for you. If you prefer the other way around (Alfred triage, Tabatha docs), that's also fine as long as we agree. Let's finalize.
Diana, Tabatha: I confirm that I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (option 2: Alfred triage, Tabatha docs, Diana review). This avoids duplicates and keeps costs low. Let's proceed to execution.
